en.p: In triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$ with $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=2\sqrt{7}$, let $\mathrm{P}$ be the midpoint of segment $\mathrm{BC}$, and let $\mathrm{Q}$ be the point that internally divides segment $\mathrm{BC}$ in the ratio $5:1$. When
what is the area of the circumcircle of triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$? [4 points]
